snippet.title: 💧 What Happens If You Sweat in Space? (Mind-Blowing!)
snippet.description:
Ever wondered about astronauts sweating in space? It's a totally different (and kinda gross!) experience than on Earth! 💦 In this Quirble, prepare to be surprised by the realities of microgravity.

Here's the sticky truth: sweat doesn't drip off your body in space! Instead, it **clings to your skin and pools there** because there's no gravity to pull it down and no airflow to evaporate it. Imagine that – it can get super itchy and uncomfortable! This is precisely why the special cooling systems inside their bulky spacesuits are absolutely vital.

It turns out, even something as simple as sweating becomes a fascinating science experiment when you're far from Earth!

Did this fact make you rethink space travel? Let us know in the comments below! 👇

snippet.title: Take Control of Your Time: 5 Vital Time Management Habits
snippet.description:
1-Page Summary: https://lozeron-academy-llc.kit.com/time-optimization
Productivity Game Academy: https://tinyurl.com/academyPG

In this video, you’ll learn 5 powerful time optimization habits you can implement this month to ensure your time goes toward what matters most—your priorities, your people, your joy, and your future.

Here’s what you’ll discover:

⏳ Habit #1: The Weekly Big 4
Plan your week around four meaningful areas—Promises, People, Personal Enjoyment, and Profit—and learn how to organize them in a simple Trello board to make every week feel fulfilling.

🧠 Habit #2: Capture & Interrogate
Dump your to-do list, then pressure-test it. Use a simple 0–100 scale to identify which tasks are actually worth your time today.

🎯 Habit #3: The Prioritizing Thought Experiment
What if you only had one hour to get something done? This thought experiment helps you immediately find your most valuable task.

📅 Habit #4: Dedicated Days
Discover how assigning themes to each day can reduce task-switching, increase focus, and help you make real progress on your biggest goals.

🔥 Habit #5: The “Hell Yeah” Filter
Say “no” to overcommitment. Learn how to only say “yes” to projects and events that truly excite you and align with your vision.

Whether you're feeling overwhelmed or simply want to level up your productivity, these five habits will help you invest your time with purpose.

snippet.title: How to be a Better Decision-Maker | 5 Habits to Counter Our Biggest Biases
snippet.description:
1-Page Summary: https://lozeron-academy-llc.kit.com/top5-decision-making

Your Brain Is Lying to You About That Big Decision 😳

Right now, your brain is working against you—and you don’t even know it.

In this video, you’ll uncover the 5 hidden cognitive biases that derail career moves, business launches, relationships, and major financial decisions. These aren’t just theoretical flaws—these are the traps responsible for most long-term regret.

But there’s good news: once you know how to spot them, you can beat them.

📘 Based on insights from Decisive, Thinking, Fast and Slow, and other top decision-making frameworks, you’ll learn how to:

- Avoid Option Blindness and uncover smarter alternatives
- Spot the Planning Fallacy before it burns time and money
- Interrupt Confirmation Bias and find the real best option
- Escape Short-termism and think like your future self
- Prevent Overcommitment before you get stuck

You’ll also get the 5B Framework—a powerful, practical method to make high-stakes decisions with clarity and confidence.

✅ Whether you’re deciding to launch a project, change careers, invest, or start something new… this guide will help you move forward without regret.

🎯 The most successful people aren’t just smart—they’re decisive.

Watch now and learn how to make decisions your future self will thank you for.

Books mentioned in this video:
- Decisive by Chip and Dan Heath
- Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman
- Creating Great Choices by Roger Martin
